summary.zh: 独立只读插件：检查当前真实 Agent 会话的 file_change，返回有界 diff 快照和 revision 绑定的分页摘要。不修改或回滚文件；所有公开工具契约归本插件。
summary.en: Independent read-only inspection of actual file_change artifacts from the authenticated Agent session, with bounded diffs and revision-bound pagination. No file writes or rollback; this plugin owns its public tool contracts.
